items.text:
Visa Application Checklist — Sponsored Family Visit (Standard Route)

Thank you for choosing to prepare your application with the Corliss Visa Advisory Service. Please review each item carefully before your appointment at the regional processing centre. Incomplete applications are returned without review, and the appointment fee is not refunded in that case.

1. Completed application form, signed and dated within the last 30 days.
2. Original passport valid for at least six months beyond the intended stay, plus a photocopy of the photo page.
3. Sponsor's invitation letter and proof of accommodation for the full period of the visit.
4. Evidence of funds: bank statements for the past three months and a recent payslip.
5. Two passport-style photographs meeting the current specification.

Processing typically takes 15–20 working days. Track your application using the reference number issued at biometrics. If any document is missing, the case officer will contact you by email; do not call the centre for status updates during peak season.
